create_InfoAudioDataset: create an InfoAudioDataset from a list of AudioMeta objects for audio training
use_AudioInfo: use AudioInfo to wrap audio metadata and convert it to conditioning attributes
preprocess_get_keyword_list: preprocess a comma or space separated string into a cleaned list of lowercase keywords
clean_get_keyword: clean and lowercase a single keyword string returning None for empty or invalid input
sanitize_get_string: sanitize a string value by stripping whitespace and returning None for empty or invalid input
